                    "Text": "/**\n * DcvInstanceConstruct\n *\n * NICE DCV가 설치된 GPU EC2 인스턴스, IAM 역할, Secrets Manager Secret,\n * CloudFormation CreationPolicy를 생성하는 L1 Construct.\n *\n * L1 Construct(Cfn* 클래스)를 사용하여 원본 CloudFormation 템플릿과\n * 1:1 대응을 유지하고, CDK synth 결과를 예측 가능하게 한다.\n */\nimport * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';\nimport * as ec2 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-ec2';\nimport * as efs from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-efs';\nimport * as iam from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-iam';\nimport * as secretsmanager from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-secretsmanager';\nimport * as s3_assets from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3-assets';\nimport { Construct } from 'constructs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\nimport { VersionProfile, VersionProfileName } from '../config/version-profiles';\n\n/**\n * DcvInstanceConstruct Props\n */\nexport interface DcvInstanceProps {\n  /** VPC 참조 */\n  vpc: ec2.CfnVPC;\n  /** 퍼블릭 서브넷 참조 */\n  publicSubnet: ec2.CfnSubnet;\n  /** DCV용 보안 그룹 참조 */\n  dcvSecurityGroup: ec2.CfnSecurityGroup;\n  /** EFS 파일 시스템 참조 */\n  efsFileSystem: efs.CfnFileSystem;\n  /** EFS 보안 그룹 참조 */\n  efsSecurityGroup: ec2.CfnSecurityGroup;\n  /** EC2 인스턴스 타입 (예: 'g6.12xlarge') */\n  instanceType: string;\n  /** 버전 프로필 설정 객체 */\n  versionProfile: VersionProfile;\n  /** 버전 프로필 이름 */\n  versionProfileName: VersionProfileName;\n  /** DCV AMI ID */\n  amiId: string;\n  /** 리소스 Name 태그 접두사 (예: 'IsaacLab-Stable-alice') */\n  namePrefix: string;\n  /** ECR 리포지토리 이름 (멀티 사용자 시 사용자별 분리) */\n  ecrRepoName?: string;\n  /** GR00T 리포지토리 URL (빈 문자열이면 GR00T 미설치) */\n  grootRepoUrl?: string;\n  /** GR00T 리포지토리 브랜치 */\n  grootBranch?: string;\n  /** CloudWatch Agent 설치 여부 (기본값: false) */\n  enableCloudWatch?: boolean;\n  /** code-server (VSCode) 설치 여부 (기본값: true) */\n  enableCodeServer?: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * DCV 인스턴스 인프라를 구성하는 Construct\n *\n * 생성 리소스:\n * - Secrets Manager Secret (DCV 비밀번호 자동 생성, 32자, 구두점 제외)\n * - IAM Role (S3 전체, ECR 전체, EFS 전체, SSM, Secrets Manager 읽기 - ARN 제한)\n * - Instance Profile\n * - EC2 Instance (GPU, 300GB EBS gp3, EBS 암호화 활성화)\n * - CloudFormation CreationPolicy (90분 타임아웃)\n * - UserData (6개 모듈 순차 실행, 환경 변수 주입, cfn-signal + reboot)\n */\nexport class DcvInstanceConstruct extends Construct {\n  /** DCV EC2 인스턴스 */\n  public readonly instance: ec2.CfnInstance;\n  /** Secrets Manager Secret ARN */\n  public readonly secretArn: string;\n\n  constructor(scope: Construct, id: string, props: DcvInstanceProps) {\n    super(scope, id);\n\n    const p = props.namePrefix;\n\n    // --- Secrets Manager Secret ---\n    // DCV 비밀번호 자동 생성 (32자, 구두점 제외)\n    const secret = new secretsmanager.CfnSecret(this, 'DcvSecret', {\n      description: 'DCV instance login password',\n      generateSecretString: {\n        secretStringTemplate: '{\"username\":\"ubuntu\"}',\n        generateStringKey: 'password',\n        passwordLength: 32,\n        excludePunctuation: true,\n        includeSpace: false,\n      },\n      tags: [{ key: 'Name', value: `${p}-Secret` }],\n    });\n    this.secretArn = secret.ref;\n\n    // --- IAM Role ---\n    // EC2 인스턴스용 역할: S3 전체, ECR 전체, EFS 전체, SSM, Secrets Manager 읽기\n    const role = new iam.CfnRole(this, 'DcvInstanceRole', {\n      assumeRolePolicyDocument: {\n        Version: '2012-10-17',\n        Statement: [\n          {\n            Effect: 'Allow',\n            Principal: { Service: 'ec2.amazonaws.com' },\n            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole',\n          },\n        ],\n      },\n      managedPolicyArns: [\n        'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess',\n        'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryFullAccess',\n        'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemFullAccess',\n        'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore',\n        ...(props.enableCloudWatch ? ['arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy'] : []),\n      ],\n      policies: [\n        {\n          policyName: 'SecretsManagerReadPolicy',\n          policyDocument: {\n            Version: '2012-10-17',\n            Statement: [\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue',\n                Resource: secret.ref,\n              },\n            ],\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          policyName: 'SageMakerCodeBuildCfnPolicy',\n          policyDocument: {\n            Version: '2012-10-17',\n            Statement: [\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: [\n                  'sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob',\n                  'sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob',\n                  'sagemaker:CreateModel',\n                  'sagemaker:CreateEndpoint',\n                  'sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig',\n                  'sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint',\n                ],\n                Resource: '*',\n              },\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: [\n                  'ecr:DescribeRepositories',\n                  'codebuild:StartBuild',\n                  'codebuild:BatchGetBuilds',\n                ],\n                Resource: '*',\n              },\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: 's3:GetObject',\n                Resource: '*',\n              },\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: 's3:PutObject',\n                Resource: '*',\n              },\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: 'cloudformation:*',\n                Resource: '*',\n              },\n              {\n                Effect: 'Allow',\n                Action: 'iam:PassRole',\n                Resource: '*',\n                Condition: {\n                  StringEquals: {\n                    'iam:PassedToService': [\n                      'sagemaker.amazonaws.com',\n                      'codebuild.amazonaws.com',\n                      'cloudformation.amazonaws.com',\n                    ],\n                  },\n                },\n              },\n            ],\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n      tags: [{ key: 'Name', value: `${p}-Role` }],\n    });\n\n    // --- Instance Profile ---\n    const instanceProfile = new iam.CfnInstanceProfile(this, 'DcvInstanceProfile', {\n      roles: [role.ref],\n    });\n\n    // --- EFS 보안 그룹에 DCV SG 소스의 NFS 인그레스 규칙 추가 ---\n    // DCV 인스턴스에서 EFS에 NFS(2049) 접근할 수 있도록\n    // CfnSecurityGroupIngress를 별도 리소스로 생성하여 순환 참조 방지\n    new ec2.CfnSecurityGroupIngress(this, 'EfsFromDcvIngress', {\n      groupId: props.efsSecurityGroup.ref,\n      ipProtocol: 'tcp',\n      fromPort: 2049,\n      toPort: 2049,\n      sourceSecurityGroupId: props.dcvSecurityGroup.ref,\n    });\n\n    // --- UserData 구성 ---\n    // 셸 스크립트를 S3 Asset으로 업로드하고, UserData에서 다운로드 후 실행\n    // (EC2 UserData 16KB 제한 회피)\n    const userdataAsset = new s3_assets.Asset(this, 'UserdataScripts', {\n      path: path.join(__dirname, '../../assets/userdata'),\n    });\n\n    const workshopAsset = new s3_assets.Asset(this, 'WorkshopAssets', {\n      path: path.join(__dirname, '../../assets/workshop'),\n    });\n\n    // UserData 부트스트랩: 환경 변수 설정 → S3에서 스크립트 다운로드 → 순차 실행\n    const userDataScript = [\n      '#!/bin/bash -v',\n      '',\n      `export NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=\"${props.versionProfile.nvidiaDriverVersion}\"`,\n      `export ISAAC_SIM_VERSION=\"${props.versionProfile.isaacSimVersion}\"`,\n      `export ROS2_DISTRO=\"${props.versionProfile.ros2Distro}\"`,\n      `export VERSION_PROFILE=\"${props.versionProfileName}\"`,\n      'export EFS_ID=\"${EfsFileSystemId}\"',\n      'export REGION=\"${AWS::Region}\"',\n      'export ACCOUNT=\"${AWS::AccountId}\"',\n      'export SECRET_ID=\"${SecretId}\"',\n      `export ECR_REPO_NAME=\"${props.ecrRepoName ?? 'isaaclab-batch'}\"`,\n      `export GROOT_REPO=\"${props.grootRepoUrl ?? ''}\"`,\n      `export GROOT_BRANCH=\"${props.grootBranch ?? 'n1.6-release'}\"`,\n      '',\n      'aws s3 cp ${UserdataScriptsUrl} /tmp/userdata-scripts.zip',\n      'unzip -o /tmp/userdata-scripts.zip -d /tmp/userdata-scripts',\n      'chmod +x /tmp/userdata-scripts/*.sh',\n      '',\n      'aws s3 cp ${WorkshopAssetsUrl} /tmp/workshop-assets.zip',\n      'unzip -o /tmp/workshop-assets.zip -d /tmp/workshop-assets',\n      'cp /tmp/workshop-assets/Dockerfile /tmp/workshop-dockerfile',\n      'cp /tmp/workshop-assets/distributed_run.bash /tmp/workshop-distributed-run',\n      '',\n      'USERDATA_EXIT=0',\n      \"trap 'USERDATA_EXIT=1' ERR\",\n      'set -o pipefail',\n      '',\n      'source /tmp/userdata-scripts/common.sh',\n      'source /tmp/userdata-scripts/nvidia-driver.sh',\n      ...(props.enableCloudWatch ? ['source /tmp/userdata-scripts/cloudwatch-agent.sh'] : []),\n      'source /tmp/userdata-scripts/isaac-lab.sh',\n      'source /tmp/userdata-scripts/efs-mount.sh',\n      'source /tmp/userdata-scripts/groot.sh',\n      ...((props.enableCodeServer ?? true) ? ['source /tmp/userdata-scripts/code-server.sh'] : []),\n      '',\n      'trap - ERR',\n      'set +e',\n      'wget https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-examples/aws-cfn-bootstrap-py3-latest.zip',\n      'unzip aws-cfn-bootstrap-py3-latest.zip',\n      'cd aws-cfn-bootstrap-2.0/',\n      'python3 setup.py install',\n      '/usr/local/bin/cfn-signal -e $USERDATA_EXIT --stack ${AWS::StackName} --resource ${InstanceLogicalId} --region ${AWS::Region}',\n      '',\n      'systemctl disable systemd-networkd-wait-online.service 2>/dev/null || true',\n      '',\n      'reboot',\n    ].join('\\n');\n\n    // --- EC2 Instance ---\n    const cfnInstance = new ec2.CfnInstance(this, 'DcvInstance', {\n      imageId: props.amiId,\n      instanceType: props.instanceType,\n      subnetId: props.publicSubnet.ref,\n      securityGroupIds: [props.dcvSecurityGroup.ref],\n      iamInstanceProfile: instanceProfile.ref,\n      blockDeviceMappings: [\n        {\n          deviceName: '/dev/sda1',\n          ebs: {\n            volumeSize: 300,\n            volumeType: 'gp3',\n            encrypted: true,\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n      // Fn.sub로 CloudFormation 의사 참조 및 리소스 참조를 치환한 후 Base64 인코딩\n      userData: cdk.Fn.base64(\n        cdk.Fn.sub(userDataScript, {\n          EfsFileSystemId: props.efsFileSystem.ref,\n          SecretId: secret.ref,\n          UserdataScriptsUrl: userdataAsset.s3ObjectUrl,\n          WorkshopAssetsUrl: workshopAsset.s3ObjectUrl,\n        }),\n      ),\n      tags: [{ key: 'Name', value: `${p}-Instance` }],\n    });\n\n    // cfn-signal의 --resource 값에 인스턴스의 논리적 ID를 사용해야 함\n    // Fn.sub에서 ${InstanceLogicalId}를 치환하기 위해 UserData를 재구성\n    // cfnInstance.logicalId를 사용하여 정확한 논리적 ID를 전달\n    const userDataWithLogicalId = userDataScript.replace(\n      '${InstanceLogicalId}',\n      cfnInstance.logicalId,\n    );\n\n    // UserData를 논리적 ID가 포함된 버전으로 업데이트\n    cfnInstance.userData = cdk.Fn.base64(\n      cdk.Fn.sub(userDataWithLogicalId, {\n        EfsFileSystemId: props.efsFileSystem.ref,\n        SecretId: secret.ref,\n        UserdataScriptsUrl: userdataAsset.s3ObjectUrl,\n        WorkshopAssetsUrl: workshopAsset.s3ObjectUrl,\n      }),\n    );\n\n    // --- CreationPolicy ---\n    // UserData 완료 시 cfn-signal을 수신하며, 타임아웃은 90분\n    // DLAMI 사용으로 드라이버/Docker 사전 설치되어 UserData 실행 시간 단축\n    (cfnInstance as cdk.CfnResource).cfnOptions.creationPolicy = {\n      resourceSignal: {\n        count: 1,\n        timeout: 'PT90M',\n      },\n    };\n\n    // 노출 속성 설정\n    this.instance = cfnInstance;\n  }\n}"

InsufficientInstanceCapacity이면 다음 AZ 시도\n * 7. 해당 타입의 모든 AZ 실패 시 다음 인스턴스 타입으로 fallback\n * 8. 모든 타입/AZ 실패 시 에러 반환\n */\nimport * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';\nimport * as iam from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-iam';\nimport * as lambda from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-lambda';\nimport { Construct } from 'constructs';\n\n/**\n * AzSelectorConstruct Props\n */\nexport interface AzSelectorProps {\n  /** 인스턴스 타입 fallback 리스트 (우선순위 순) */\n  instanceTypes: string[];\n  /** 탐색에 사용할 AMI ID */\n  amiId: string;\n}\n\n/** 기본 인스턴스 타입 fallback 순서 */\nexport const DEFAULT_INSTANCE_TYPE_FALLBACK = [\n  'g6e.4xlarge',  // L40S × 1 — 고성능 단일 GPU\n  'g6.4xlarge',   // L4 × 1 — 단일 GPU (vCPU 16, 64GB)\n  'g6.12xlarge',  // L4 × 4 — 분산 학습 최적\n  'g6e.12xlarge', // L40S × 4 — 고성능 분산 학습\n];\n\n/**\n * 배포 시점에 GPU capacity가 있는 AZ와 인스턴스 타입을 자동 탐색하는 Construct\n */\nexport class AzSelectorConstruct extends Construct {\n  /** 탐색된 가용 영역 이름 (CloudFormation 런타임 값) */\n  public readonly availabilityZone: string;\n  /** 탐색된 인스턴스 타입 (CloudFormation 런타임 값) */\n  public readonly resolvedInstanceType: string;\n\n  constructor(scope: Construct, id: string, props: AzSelectorProps) {\n    super(scope, id);\n\n    const lambdaRole = new iam.Role(this, 'AzSelectorRole', {\n      assumedBy: new iam.ServicePrincipal('lambda.amazonaws.com'),\n      managedPolicies: [\n        iam.ManagedPolicy.fromAwsManagedPolicyName('service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'),\n      ],\n      inlinePolicies: {\n        AzSelectorPolicy: new iam.PolicyDocument({\n          statements: [\n            new iam.PolicyStatement({\n              actions: [\n                'ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings',\n                'ec2:RunInstances',\n                'ec2:TerminateInstances',\n                'ec2:DescribeInstances',\n                'ec2:CreateTags',\n              ],\n              resources: ['*'],\n            }),\n          ],\n        }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    const azSelectorFn = new lambda.Function(this, 'AzSelectorFunction', {\n      runtime: lambda.Runtime.PYTHON_3_12,\n      handler: 'index.handler',\n      role: lambdaRole,\n      timeout: cdk.Duration.minutes(10),\n      code: lambda.Code.fromInline(AZ_SELECTOR_LAMBDA_CODE),\n      description: 'Finds AZ + instance type with GPU capacity by trial launch with fallback',\n    });\n\n    const customResource = new cdk.CustomResource(this, 'AzSelectorResource', {\n      serviceToken: azSelectorFn.functionArn,\n      properties: {\n        InstanceTypes: props.instanceTypes.join(','),\n        AmiId: props.amiId,\n        Timestamp: Date.now().toString(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    azSelectorFn.addPermission('CfnInvoke', {\n      principal: new iam.ServicePrincipal('cloudformation.amazonaws.com'),\n    });\n\n    this.availabilityZone = customResource.getAttString('AvailabilityZone');\n    this.resolvedInstanceType = customResource.getAttString('InstanceType');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * AZ + 인스턴스 타입 탐색 Lambda 코드 (Python 인라인)\n *\n * 인스턴스 타입 fallback 리스트를 순차 시도하여\n * capacity가 있는 AZ + 인스턴스 타입 조합을 찾는다.\n */\nconst AZ_SELECTOR_LAMBDA_CODE = `\nimport json\nimport boto3\nimport random\nimport cfnresponse\n\ndef handler(event, context):\n    print(json.dumps(event))\n\n    if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':\n        cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {},\n            physicalResourceId=event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'az-selector-deleted'))\n        return\n\n    try:\n        instance_types = event['ResourceProperties']['InstanceTypes'].split(',')\n        ami_id = event['ResourceProperties']['AmiId']\n        region = context.invoked_function_arn.split(':')[3]\n\n        ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=region)\n\n        all_tried = []\n\n        for instance_type in instance_types:\n            print(f'--- Trying instance type: {instance_type} ---')\n\n            # 지원 AZ 목록 조회\n            resp = ec2.describe_instance_type_offerings(\n                LocationType='availability-zone',\n                Filters=[{'Name': 'instance-type', 'Values': [instance_type]}]\n            )\n            azs = [o['Location'] for o in resp['InstanceTypeOfferings']]\n            print(f'Supported AZs for {instance_type}: {azs}')\n\n            if not azs:\n                print(f'{instance_type} is not available in any AZ, skipping...')\n                all_tried.append(f'{instance_type}(no AZ)')\n                continue\n\n            random.shuffle(azs)\n\n            for az in azs:\n                print(f'Trying {instance_type} in {az}')\n                try:\n                    run_resp = ec2.run_instances(\n                        InstanceType=instance_type,\n                        ImageId=ami_id,\n                        MinCount=1,\n                        MaxCount=1,\n                        Placement={'AvailabilityZone': az},\n                        TagSpecifications=[{\n                            'ResourceType': 'instance',\n                            'Tags': [{'Key': 'Name', 'Value': 'az-selector-probe'}]\n                        }]\n                    )\n                    instance_id = run_resp['Instances'][0]['InstanceId']\n                    print(f'SUCCESS: {instance_type} in {az} (probe: {instance_id})')\n\n                    ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])\n                    print(f'Terminated probe {instance_id}')\n\n                    cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,\n                        {'AvailabilityZone': az, 'InstanceType': instance_type},\n                        physicalResourceId=f'az-selector-{az}-{instance_type}')\n                    return\n\n                except Exception as e:\n                    error_msg = str(e)\n                    if 'InsufficientInstanceCapacity' in error_msg:\n                        print(f'InsufficientCapacity: {instance_type} in {az}')\n                        all_tried.append(f'{instance_type}/{az}')\n                        continue\n                    elif 'Unsupported' in error_msg:\n                        print(f'Unsupported: {instance_type} in {az}')\n                        all_tried.append(f'{instance_type}/{az}(unsupported)')\n                        continue\n                    else:\n                        print(f'Unexpected error: {e}')\n                        raise\n\n            print(f'All AZs exhausted for {instance_type}, falling back...')\n\n        cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {},\n            reason=f'No capacity available for any instance type in any AZ: {all_tried}',\n            physicalResourceId='az-selector-failed')\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f'Error: {e}')\n        cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {},\n            reason=str(e),\n            physicalResourceId='az-selector-error')\n`;"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },

            "kind": "thinking",
            "data": {
              "text": " Looking at the failure event, the EC2 instance launched fine and AzSelector had capacity, but the UserData script itself failed — the trap handler caught an exit code of 1 during execution.\n\nNow I need to dig into what actually broke in that UserData script by checking the instance's console output, its type, and the CloudFormation event timeline to see what else succeeded or failed.",
              "signature": "",
              "redactedContent": []
            }
          },
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "스택 자체 실패는 `DcvInstance054FF2AE` 인스턴스가 cfn-signal로 FAILURE를 보냈기 때문입니다(`i-0434b9fef9ec8328c`). 즉, EC2는 뜨는 데 성공했지만 **UserData 부트스트랩이 실패**했습니다. 인스턴스 타입과 콘솔 로그를 확인하겠습니다."
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "tooluse_t1pRGlFXvkOCQ5T7nU0X2U",
              "name": "shell",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "실패 인스턴스 상세 정보 및 콘솔 로그 조회 (병렬)",
                "command": "unset AWS_PROFILE AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE; export AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/Users/seokju/.sbox-session/77d453e4-0368-4357-82c5-abcaf48d3e36/creds;\necho \"=== Instance details ===\"\naws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0434b9fef9ec8328c --region us-east-1 --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].[InstanceId,InstanceType,ImageId,State.Name,Placement.AvailabilityZone,LaunchTime,PrivateIpAddress,PublicIpAddress]' --output table 2>&1\necho \"\"\necho \"=== Stack events (chronological, all) ===\"\naws cloudformation describe-stack-events --stack-name IsaacLab-Stable-seokju --region us-east-1 --query \"reverse(StackEvents[].[Timestamp,LogicalResourceId,ResourceType,ResourceStatus,ResourceStatusReason])\" --output json 2>&1 | head -300"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }

        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "thinking",
            "data": {
              "text": " Looking at the console output, the instance did boot successfully, but CloudFormation terminated during shutdown when the SSM Agent hit a network timeout trying to reach the AWS Systems Manager endpoint in us-east-1. The connection failed at the TCP level, suggesting either a networking misconfiguration or the instance lost connectivity before the shutdown completed. I'm piecing together the timeline now — the UserData ran for about 22 minutes on the first boot, then failed with a trap on ERR that set USERDATA_EXIT=1, triggering the reboot. The console output we're seeing is from the second boot and shutdown, not the first boot where the actual UserData execution happened. Since the instance is already terminated, the EBS volume is gone too, but I can work backwards from the clues in the output — GR00T Inference Server started, code-server came up, EFS mount was attempted — which suggests most of the setup modules succeeded before something failed and triggered the trap. The cfn-signal failure means any single command error in the sourced modules caused the whole script to bail out.",
              "signature": "",
              "redactedContent": []
            }
          },
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "콘솔 출력이 두 번째 부팅 이후(reboot 후)만 보입니다. 첫 번째 부팅의 UserData 실행 로그가 필요합니다. `--latest` 플래그로 최신 로그를 가져오고, 각 UserData 스크립트에서 실패 가능성이 높은 부분을 확인해보겠습니다."
          },

      "version": "v1",
      "kind": "ToolResults",
      "data": {
        "message_id": "74c931fb-ba66-4451-945b-70fa768e5ec3",
        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "toolResult",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "tooluse_zTcxWYw2uKHPVF3idEg21D",
              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# common.sh - 시스템 공통 설정 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# 시스템 업데이트, 데스크톱 환경, NICE DCV, ROS, Docker 설치 및\n# DCV 설정과 비밀번호 설정을 수행한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   REGION    - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n#   SECRET_ID - Secrets Manager Secret ARN\n# =============================================================================\n\n# 로그 리다이렉션 설정 - 모든 출력을 /var/log/user-data.log에 기록\nexec > >(tee /var/log/user-data.log) 2>&1\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: common.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. dpkg lock 해제 대기\n#    Ubuntu AMI 부팅 직후 unattended-upgrades가 dpkg lock을 잡고 있을 수 있다.\n#    lock이 해제될 때까지 최대 5분간 대기한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\necho \"dpkg lock 해제 대기 중...\"\nfor i in $(seq 1 60); do\n  if ! fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    echo \"dpkg lock 해제 확인 (${i}회 시도)\"\n    break\n  fi\n  echo \"dpkg lock 사용 중... 5초 대기 (${i}/60)\"\n  sleep 5\ndone\n\n# unattended-upgrades 비활성화 (이후 lock 충돌 방지)\nsystemctl stop unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true\nsystemctl disable unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1.5. AWS CLI v2 fallback 설치\n#      DLAMI에는 사전 설치되어 있으므로 스킵됨.\n#      일반 Ubuntu AMI로 배포하는 경우를 대비한 보험 로직.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif ! which aws > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  echo \"AWS CLI가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. AWS CLI v2를 설치합니다...\"\n  apt-get install -y unzip\n  curl -fsSL \"https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip\" -o \"/tmp/awscliv2.zip\"\n  unzip -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp\n  /tmp/aws/install\n  rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/aws\n  echo \"AWS CLI v2 설치 완료: $(aws --version)\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. 시스템 업데이트 및 업그레이드\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. 데스크톱 환경 설치\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서는 install-desktop.sh가 GDM을 설치하지 않을 수 있으므로\n#    ubuntu-desktop을 직접 설치한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nUBUNTU_VERSION=$(lsb_release -rs)\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  apt-get install -y ubuntu-desktop\nelse\n  wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-desktop.sh\n  bash ./install-desktop.sh\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. NICE DCV 설치\n#    install-dcv.sh는 Ubuntu 22.04/18.04만 지원하므로,\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서는 직접 DCV 패키지를 다운로드하여 설치한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  echo \"Ubuntu 24.04 감지 - DCV 직접 설치 (DCV GL 포함)\"\n  wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz\n  tar -xvzf nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz\n  cd nice-dcv-*-x86_64\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-server_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-web-viewer_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-xdcv_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-gl_*.deb\n  usermod -aG video dcv || true\n  systemctl enable dcvserver || true\n  cd /root\nelse\n  echo \"Ubuntu 22.04 감지 - DCV 설치 (DCV GL 포함)\"\n  wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-dcv.sh\n  bash ./install-dcv.sh\n  # DCV GL 추가 설치 (install-dcv.sh가 DCV GL을 설치하지 않는 경우 대비)\n  if ! dpkg -l nice-dcv-gl 2>/dev/null | grep -q \"^ii\"; then\n    echo \"DCV GL 미설치 감지 - DCV GL을 추가 설치합니다...\"\n    wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/NICE-GPG-KEY\n    gpg --import NICE-GPG-KEY 2>/dev/null || true\n    wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/nice-dcv-ubuntu2204-x86_64.tgz\n    tar -xzf nice-dcv-ubuntu2204-x86_64.tgz\n    cd nice-dcv-*-x86_64\n    apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-gl*.deb\n    cd /root\n  fi\nfi\n\n# DCV GL 활성화 (nvidia-driver.sh에서 xorg.conf 생성 후 reboot 시 적용됨)\nif which dcvgladmin > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  dcvgladmin disable 2>/dev/null || true\n  dcvgladmin enable 2>/dev/null || true\n  echo \"DCV GL 활성화 완료\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. ROS2 설치 (공식 저장소 사용)\n#    ROS2_DISTRO 환경 변수로 배포판 결정 (humble/jazzy)\n#    외부 install-ros.sh 스크립트 대신 직접 설치\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\necho \"ROS2 ${ROS2_DISTRO} 설치 시작...\"\n\n# locale 설정\napt-get install -y locales\nlocale-gen en_US en_US.UTF-8 || true\nupdate-locale LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANG=en_US.UTF-8\nexport LANG=en_US.UTF-8\n\n# ROS2 GPG 키 및 저장소 등록\napt-get install -y software-properties-common curl\ncurl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros/rosdistro/master/ros.key -o /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg\necho \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg] http://packages.ros.org/ros2/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $UBUNTU_CODENAME) main\" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list > /dev/null\n\n# ROS2 설치\napt-get update\napt-get install -y ros-${ROS2_DISTRO}-desktop\n\n# rosdep 초기화\n# Ubuntu 24.04(Jazzy)에서는 python3-rosdep2 apt 패키지가 없고,\n# DLAMI에 pip3도 미설치이므로 python3-pip 설치 후 pip로 rosdep 설치\nif apt-cache show python3-rosdep2 2>/dev/null | grep -q \"^Package:\"; then\n  apt-get install -y python3-rosdep2\nelse\n  apt-get install -y python3-pip\n  pip3 install --break-system-packages rosdep\nfi\nrosdep init 2>/dev/null || true\nrosdep update || true\n\n# ROS2 환경 설정을 .bashrc에 추가\necho \"source /opt/ros/${ROS2_DISTRO}/setup.bash\" >> /home/ubuntu/.bashrc\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. Docker 설치 (External_Script)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nwget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-docker.sh\nbash ./install-docker.sh\n\n# ubuntu 사용자를 docker 그룹에 추가 (sudo 없이 docker 명령 실행 가능)\nusermod -aG docker ubuntu || true\n\n# 터미널 모노스페이스 폰트 설정 (DCV에서 글자 간격이 넓어지는 문제 방지)\nrunuser -l ubuntu -c \"gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface monospace-font-name 'Mono Regular 12'\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. DCV 설정 파일 작성\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncat << 'EOF' > /etc/dcv/dcv.conf\n[license]\n[log]\n[session-management]\ncreate-session=true\n[session-management/defaults]\n[session-management/automatic-console-session]\nowner = \"ubuntu\"\nuser = \"ubuntu\"\n[display]\n[connectivity]\nweb-port=8443\n[security]\n[clipboard]\nprimary-selection-paste=true\nprimary-selection-copy=true\nEOF\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 7. 그래픽 관련 패키지 설치 및 GPU 설정\n#    Ubuntu 24.04는 기본 Wayland 모드이므로 DCV를 위해 X11로 전환한다.\n#    GPU X 설정은 NVIDIA 드라이버 설치 후에 실행해야 하므로\n#    nvidia-driver.sh에서 처리한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt install -y mesa-utils openbox\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  echo \"Ubuntu 24.04 - Wayland 비활성화 + GDM AutomaticLogin 설정\"\n  # GDM이 설치되어 있으면 설정 적용\n  if [ -f /etc/gdm3/custom.conf ]; then\n    sed -i '/\\[daemon\\]/a WaylandEnable=false\\nAutomaticLoginEnable=true\\nAutomaticLogin=ubuntu' /etc/gdm3/custom.conf 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\n  systemctl set-default graphical.target || true\n  systemctl enable gdm 2>/dev/null || true\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 8. graphics-restart systemd 서비스 생성 및 활성화\n#    DCV 서버 시작 후 그래픽 타겟을 재시작하여 디스플레이를 초기화한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/graphics-restart.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=Restart graphical.target\nAfter=dcvserver.service\n\n[Service]\nExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl isolate graphical.target\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nEOF\n\nsystemctl daemon-reload || true\nsystemctl enable graphics-restart.service || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. Secrets Manager에서 비밀번호 조회 및 ubuntu 사용자 비밀번호 설정\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서 SSSD PAM 간섭으로 chpasswd가 실패할 수 있으므로\n#    usermod --password로 직접 설정한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nPASS=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id ${SECRET_ID} --output text --query SecretString --region ${REGION} | jq -r .password)\nHASH=$(echo \"$PASS\" | openssl passwd -6 -stdin)\nusermod --password \"$HASH\" ubuntu || true\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: common.sh =====\""
                },
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# nvidia-driver.sh - NVIDIA 드라이버 및 컨테이너 툴킷 설치 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# NVIDIA GPU 드라이버, nvidia-container-toolkit, nvidia-persistenced를 설치한다.\n# DLAMI에 사전 설치된 드라이버 버전에 따라 적절히 처리한다.\n#\n# nvidia-xconfig는 사용하지 않는다. 멀티 GPU 환경에서 --enable-all-gpus가\n# 4개 Screen을 생성하여 DCV와 충돌하므로, DCV 최적화 xorg.conf를 직접 생성한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION - NVIDIA 드라이버 메이저 버전 (예: '570')\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: nvidia-driver.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. NVIDIA 드라이버 설치/교체\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif nvidia-smi > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  INSTALLED_VER=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader | head -1)\n  INSTALLED_MAJOR=$(echo \"$INSTALLED_VER\" | cut -d. -f1)\n  echo \"NVIDIA 드라이버 감지: ${INSTALLED_VER} (메이저: ${INSTALLED_MAJOR}), 요청: ${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}\"\n\n  if [ \"$INSTALLED_MAJOR\" = \"$NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION\" ]; then\n    echo \"드라이버 메이저 버전 일치. 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  elif [ \"$INSTALLED_MAJOR\" = \"550\" ] && [ \"$NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION\" = \"570\" ]; then\n    echo \"DLAMI 550 드라이버 감지. apt로 570 업그레이드합니다...\"\n    apt-get update\n    apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server\n    apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    echo \"nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server 업그레이드 완료\"\n  else\n    echo \"드라이버 메이저 버전 불일치 (${INSTALLED_MAJOR} != ${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}). 교체합니다...\"\n    nvidia-uninstall --silent 2>/dev/null || true\n    dkms remove nvidia/${INSTALLED_VER} --all 2>/dev/null || true\n    apt-get remove --purge -y \"nvidia-fabricmanager*\" 2>/dev/null || true\n    apt-get update\n    apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    echo \"nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server 교체 완료\"\n  fi\nelse\n  echo \"NVIDIA 드라이버 미설치. nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server를 설치합니다...\"\n  apt-get update\n  apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server\n  apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. DCV 최적화 xorg.conf 생성 (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 모두)\n#    lspci로 첫 번째 NVIDIA GPU의 PCI BusID를 조회한다.\n#    nvidia-smi는 드라이버 교체 직후 커널 모듈 불일치로 실패할 수 있으므로 사용하지 않는다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nGPU_PCI_SLOT=$(lspci | grep -i nvidia | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)\nif [ -n \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" ]; then\n  # lspci 형식: 38:00.0 → PCI:56:0:0 (16진수 → 10진수)\n  BUS_HEX=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d: -f1)\n  DEV_HEX=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d: -f2 | cut -d. -f1)\n  FUNC_NUM=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d. -f2)\n  BUS_DEC=$((16#$BUS_HEX))\n  DEV_DEC=$((16#$DEV_HEX))\n  echo \"첫 번째 GPU BusID: PCI:${BUS_DEC}:${DEV_DEC}:${FUNC_NUM}\"\n\n  cat > /etc/X11/xorg.conf << XORGEOF\nSection \"ServerLayout\"\n    Identifier     \"Layout0\"\n    Screen      0  \"Screen0\" 0 0\n    InputDevice    \"Keyboard0\" \"CoreKeyboard\"\n    InputDevice    \"Mouse0\" \"CorePointer\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"InputDevice\"\n    Identifier     \"Keyboard0\"\n    Driver         \"kbd\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"InputDevice\"\n    Identifier     \"Mouse0\"\n    Driver         \"mouse\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Monitor\"\n    Identifier     \"Monitor0\"\n    VendorName     \"Unknown\"\n    ModelName      \"Unknown\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Device\"\n    Identifier     \"Device0\"\n    Driver         \"nvidia\"\n    BusID          \"PCI:${BUS_DEC}:${DEV_DEC}:${FUNC_NUM}\"\n    Option         \"HardDPMS\" \"false\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Screen\"\n    Identifier     \"Screen0\"\n    Device         \"Device0\"\n    Monitor        \"Monitor0\"\n    DefaultDepth    24\n    SubSection     \"Display\"\n        Virtual     4096 2160\n        Depth       24\n    EndSubSection\nEndSection\nXORGEOF\n  echo \"DCV 최적화 xorg.conf 생성 완료\"\nelse\n  echo \"lspci에서 NVIDIA GPU를 찾을 수 없습니다. xorg.conf 생성을 건너뜁니다.\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. nvidia-container-toolkit 설치 (DLAMI에 사전 설치된 경우 스킵)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif which nvidia-ctk > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  echo \"nvidia-container-toolkit이 이미 설치되어 있습니다.\"\nelse\n  echo \"nvidia-container-toolkit을 설치합니다...\"\n  curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg\n  curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \\\n    sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \\\n    tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list\n  apt-get update\n  apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Docker 재시작 + nvidia-persistenced 활성화\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nsystemctl restart docker || true\nsystemctl enable nvidia-persistenced || true\nsystemctl start nvidia-persistenced || true\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: nvidia-driver.sh =====\""

                  "data": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# isaac-lab.sh - Isaac Lab Docker 이미지 빌드 및 ECR 푸시 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# IsaacLab 리포지토리를 클론하고, Workshop_Asset(Dockerfile, distributed_run.bash)을\n# 다운로드한 후, Dockerfile에서 Isaac Sim 버전을 패치하여 Docker 이미지를 빌드하고\n# ECR에 푸시한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   ISAAC_SIM_VERSION - Isaac Sim 버전 (예: '4.5.0', '5.1.0', '')\n#   REGION            - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n#   ACCOUNT           - AWS 계정 ID\n#   ECR_REPO_NAME     - ECR 리포지토리 이름 (기본: isaaclab-batch)\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: isaac-lab.sh =====\"\n\n# ECR 리포지토리 이름 기본값\nif [ -z \"$ECR_REPO_NAME\" ]; then\n  ECR_REPO_NAME=\"isaaclab-batch\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. ISAAC_SIM_VERSION이 비어있으면 스킵\n#    isaacSimVersion이 빈 문자열인 프로필에서는 Isaac Sim/Lab 설치를 건너뛴다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif [ -z \"${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}\" ]; then\n  echo \"ISAAC_SIM_VERSION이 설정되지 않음. Isaac Lab 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  echo \"===== [$(date)] END: isaac-lab.sh (SKIPPED) =====\"\nelse\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. IsaacLab 리포지토리 클론\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment\ngit clone https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab.git\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/IsaacLab\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment/IsaacLab\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. Workshop 에셋 복사 (Dockerfile, distributed_run.bash)\n#    dcv-instance.ts가 UserData 시작 부분에서 /tmp에 기록한 파일을 복사한다.\n#    외부 S3 URL 의존성 없이 리포에 내장된 에셋을 사용한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncp /tmp/workshop-dockerfile Dockerfile\ncp /tmp/workshop-distributed-run distributed_run.bash\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Dockerfile에서 Isaac Sim 버전 sed 패치\n#    베이스 이미지를 지정된 버전으로 교체하고,\n#    Isaac Sim 5.x 이상에서는 추가 EULA 동의가 필요하다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nsed -i \"s|FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim:.*|FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim:${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}|g\" Dockerfile\n\nMAJOR_VER=$(echo \"${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}\" | cut -d. -f1)\nif [ \"${MAJOR_VER}\" -ge 5 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n  # 5.x: ACCEPT_EULA + OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA + USER root\n  sed -i '/^FROM/a ENV ACCEPT_EULA=Y\\nENV OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA=YES\\nUSER root' Dockerfile\nelse\n  # 4.x: EULA 불필요\n  :\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. Docker 이미지 빌드\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndocker build -t ${ECR_REPO_NAME}:latest .\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. ECR 리포지토리 생성 및 이미지 푸시\n#    || true로 이미 존재하는 리포지토리에 대한 에러를 방지한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\naws ecr create-repository --repository-name ${ECR_REPO_NAME} --region ${REGION} || true\naws ecr get-login-password --region ${REGION} | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${ACCOUNT}.dkr.ecr.${REGION}.amazonaws.com\ndocker tag ${ECR_REPO_NAME}:latest ${ACCOUNT}.dkr.ecr.${REGION}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPO_NAME}:latest\ndocker push ${ACCOUNT}.dkr.ecr.${REGION}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPO_NAME}:latest\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: isaac-lab.sh =====\"\nfi"

                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# efs-mount.sh - EFS 마운트 및 사전 학습 모델 다운로드 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# EFS 파일 시스템을 /home/ubuntu/environment/efs에 마운트하고,\n# 사전 학습된 모델 파일(agent_72000.pt)을 EFS에 다운로드한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   EFS_ID - EFS 파일 시스템 ID (예: fs-xxxxxxxx)\n#   REGION - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: efs-mount.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. nfs-common 설치\n#    NFS v4 마운트에 필요한 패키지를 설치한다.\n#    (amazon-efs-utils는 Ubuntu 기본 저장소에 없으므로 nfs-common 사용)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt-get install -y nfs-common\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. EFS 마운트 디렉토리 생성 및 마운트\n#    NFS v4.1 프로토콜로 EFS 파일 시스템을 마운트한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\nmount -t nfs4 -o nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2 ${EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2-1. fstab에 EFS 마운트 항목 등록 (reboot 후 자동 재마운트)\n#      중복 등록을 방지하기 위해 grep으로 기존 항목을 확인한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nFSTAB_ENTRY=\"${EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs nfs4 nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2,_netdev,nofail 0 0\"\nif ! grep -q \"${EFS_ID}.efs\" /etc/fstab; then\n  echo \"$FSTAB_ENTRY\" >> /etc/fstab\n  echo \"fstab에 EFS 마운트 항목 등록 완료\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. 사전 학습된 모델 파일 다운로드\n#    Workshop_Asset 중 agent_72000.pt를 EFS에 다운로드한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nwget -P /home/ubuntu/environment/efs https://ws-assets-prod-iad-r-pdx-f3b3f9f1a7d6a3d0.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/075ce3fe-6888-4ea9-986e-5bdd1b767ef7/agent_72000.pt || echo \"[WARN] 사전 학습 모델 다운로드 실패 — 수동 다운로드 필요\"\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: efs-mount.sh =====\""

                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# groot.sh - GR00T N1 Docker 빌드 + 추론 서버 systemd 서비스 설정\n# =============================================================================\n# GR00T 리포지토리를 클론하고, Docker 이미지를 빌드하며,\n# 부팅 시 자동으로 추론 서버를 실행하는 systemd 서비스를 등록한다.\n# EFS에 GR00T-N1.6-3B 모델 가중치를 다운로드한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   GROOT_REPO   - GR00T GitHub 리포지토리 URL\n#   GROOT_BRANCH - GR00T 리포지토리 브랜치\n#   EFS_ID       - EFS 파일 시스템 ID\n#   REGION       - AWS 리전\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: groot.sh =====\"\n\n# GROOT_REPO가 비어있으면 스킵\nif [ -z \"$GROOT_REPO\" ]; then\n  echo \"GROOT_REPO가 설정되지 않음. GR00T 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  echo \"===== [$(date)] END: groot.sh (SKIPPED) =====\"\n  return 0\nfi\n\n# --- 1. HuggingFace에서 GR00T 모델 가중치 다운로드 (EFS) ---\n# Ubuntu 24.04 DLAMI에는 pip3가 미설치이므로 먼저 확인\nif ! which pip3 > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  apt-get install -y python3-pip\nfi\npip3 install --break-system-packages -q huggingface_hub\nif [ ! -d /home/ubuntu/environment/efs/GR00T-N1.6-3B ]; then\n  python3 -c \"from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-3B', local_dir='/home/ubuntu/environment/efs/GR00T-N1.6-3B')\"\nfi\n\n# --- 2. GR00T 리포지토리 클론 + Dockerfile 생성 ---\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\ngit clone --branch $GROOT_BRANCH $GROOT_REPO gr00t\n\ncat << 'GROOT_DOCKERFILE' > Dockerfile\nFROM nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.04-py3\nENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive\nENV PIP_CONSTRAINT=\"\"\nCOPY gr00t/ /workspace/gr00t/\nWORKDIR /workspace/gr00t\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e .\nEXPOSE 5555\nENTRYPOINT [\"python\"]\nCMD [\"gr00t/eval/run_gr00t_server.py\"]\nGROOT_DOCKERFILE\n\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\n\n# --- 3. GR00T Docker 빌드 systemd 서비스 ---\ncat << 'GROOTSVC' > /etc/systemd/system/groot-docker-build.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=GR00T Docker Build\nAfter=docker.service\nRequires=docker.service\nConditionPathExists=!/var/groot-done\n\n[Service]\nType=oneshot\nRemainAfterExit=yes\nExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'docker build -t groot-n1:latest /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker && touch /var/groot-done'\nExecStartPost=/bin/systemctl --no-block start groot-inference.service\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nGROOTSVC\n\n# --- 4. GR00T 추론 서버 systemd 서비스 ---\ncat << GROOTINFSVC > /etc/systemd/system/groot-inference.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=GR00T Inference Server\nAfter=groot-docker-build.service network-online.target\nWants=network-online.target\n\n[Service]\nType=simple\nRestart=on-failure\nExecStartPre=/bin/bash -c 'mount -t nfs4 -o nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2 $EFS_ID.efs.$REGION.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs 2>/dev/null || true'\nExecStart=docker run --rm --gpus all --name groot-inference --network=host -v /home/ubuntu/environment/efs:/workspace/weights groot-n1:latest gr00t/eval/run_gr00t_server.py --model_path /workspace/weights/GR00T-N1.6-3B --embodiment_tag GR1 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5555\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nGROOTINFSVC\n\nsystemctl daemon-reload\nsystemctl enable groot-docker-build.service\nsystemctl enable groot-inference.service\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: groot.sh =====\""
                },

                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "#!/bin/bash\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: code-server.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. Architecture detection\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nARCH=$(uname -m)\ncase \"$ARCH\" in\n    x86_64)  ARCH_LABEL=\"amd64\";  NODE_ARCH=\"x64\" ;;\n    aarch64) ARCH_LABEL=\"arm64\";  NODE_ARCH=\"arm64\" ;;\n    *)       echo \"[WARN] Unsupported architecture: $ARCH, skipping code-server\"; return 0 ;;\nesac\n\nCODE_SERVER_VERSION=\"4.110.0\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. Node.js 20 (required for Claude Code CLI)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif command -v node &>/dev/null && [ \"$(node -v | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d 'v')\" -ge 20 ]; then\n    echo \"[INFO] Node.js already installed: $(node -v)\"\nelse\n    echo \"[INFO] Installing Node.js 20...\"\n    NODE_VERSION=20.18.0\n    wget -q \"https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz\" -O /tmp/node.tar.xz\n    tar -xf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1\n    rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz\n    echo \"[OK] Node.js installed: $(node -v)\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. code-server binary\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif command -v code-server &>/dev/null; then\n    echo \"[INFO] code-server already installed: $(code-server --version 2>/dev/null | head -1)\"\nelse\n    echo \"[INFO] Installing code-server v${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}...\"\n    cd /tmp\n    CS_TAR=\"code-server-${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}-linux-${ARCH_LABEL}.tar.gz\"\n    CS_DIR=\"code-server-${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}-linux-${ARCH_LABEL}\"\n    wget -q \"https://github.com/coder/code-server/releases/download/v${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}/${CS_TAR}\" || { echo \"[WARN] code-server download failed\"; return 0; }\n    tar -xzf \"$CS_TAR\"\n    rm -rf /usr/local/lib/code-server\n    mv \"$CS_DIR\" /usr/local/lib/code-server\n    ln -sf /usr/local/lib/code-server/bin/code-server /usr/local/bin/code-server\n    rm -f \"$CS_TAR\"\n    echo \"[OK] code-server installed\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Retrieve password from Secrets Manager (same as DCV)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nPASS=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id ${SECRET_ID} --output text --query SecretString --region ${REGION} | jq -r .password)\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. code-server configuration\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/.config/code-server\ncat > /home/ubuntu/.config/code-server/config.yaml <<EOF\nbind-addr: 0.0.0.0:8888\nauth: password\npassword: \"${PASS}\"\ncert: false\nEOF\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/.config/code-server\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. systemd service\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncat > /etc/systemd/system/code-server.service <<EOF\n[Unit]\nDescription=code-server\nAfter=network.target\n\n[Service]\nType=simple\nUser=ubuntu\nWorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu\nEnvironment=\"PASSWORD=${PASS}\"\nExecStart=/usr/local/bin/code-server --config /home/ubuntu/.config/code-server/config.yaml\nRestart=always\nRestartSec=10\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nEOF\n\nsystemctl daemon-reload\nsystemctl enable code-server\nsystemctl start code-server || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 7. Claude Code CLI\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif command -v claude &>/dev/null; then\n    echo \"[INFO] Claude Code already installed\"\nelse\n    echo \"[INFO] Installing Claude Code CLI...\"\n    npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2>/dev/null || echo \"[WARN] Claude Code CLI install failed\"\n    NPM_PREFIX=\"$(npm prefix -g 2>/dev/null)\"\n    if [ -n \"$NPM_PREFIX\" ] && [ -f \"$NPM_PREFIX/bin/claude\" ] && ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then\n        ln -sf \"$NPM_PREFIX/bin/claude\" /usr/local/bin/claude\n    fi\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 8. Claude Code VSCode extension\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\necho \"[INFO] Installing Claude Code VSCode extension...\"\nsudo -u ubuntu code-server --install-extension Anthropic.claude-code 2>/dev/null || {\n    VSIX_URL=$(curl -s \"https://open-vsx.org/api/Anthropic/claude-code/latest\" | python3 -c \"import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('files',{}).get('download',''))\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"\")\n    if [ -n \"$VSIX_URL\" ]; then\n        curl -sL \"$VSIX_URL\" -o /tmp/claude-code.vsix\n        sudo -u ubuntu code-server --install-extension /tmp/claude-code.vsix 2>/dev/null || echo \"[WARN] Claude Code extension install failed\"\n        rm -f /tmp/claude-code.vsix\n    else\n        echo \"[WARN] Claude Code extension install failed\"\n    fi\n}\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: code-server.sh =====\""
                }

              "status": "success"

                    "Text": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# common.sh - 시스템 공통 설정 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# 시스템 업데이트, 데스크톱 환경, NICE DCV, ROS, Docker 설치 및\n# DCV 설정과 비밀번호 설정을 수행한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   REGION    - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n#   SECRET_ID - Secrets Manager Secret ARN\n# =============================================================================\n\n# 로그 리다이렉션 설정 - 모든 출력을 /var/log/user-data.log에 기록\nexec > >(tee /var/log/user-data.log) 2>&1\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: common.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. dpkg lock 해제 대기\n#    Ubuntu AMI 부팅 직후 unattended-upgrades가 dpkg lock을 잡고 있을 수 있다.\n#    lock이 해제될 때까지 최대 5분간 대기한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\necho \"dpkg lock 해제 대기 중...\"\nfor i in $(seq 1 60); do\n  if ! fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    echo \"dpkg lock 해제 확인 (${i}회 시도)\"\n    break\n  fi\n  echo \"dpkg lock 사용 중... 5초 대기 (${i}/60)\"\n  sleep 5\ndone\n\n# unattended-upgrades 비활성화 (이후 lock 충돌 방지)\nsystemctl stop unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true\nsystemctl disable unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1.5. AWS CLI v2 fallback 설치\n#      DLAMI에는 사전 설치되어 있으므로 스킵됨.\n#      일반 Ubuntu AMI로 배포하는 경우를 대비한 보험 로직.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif ! which aws > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  echo \"AWS CLI가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. AWS CLI v2를 설치합니다...\"\n  apt-get install -y unzip\n  curl -fsSL \"https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip\" -o \"/tmp/awscliv2.zip\"\n  unzip -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp\n  /tmp/aws/install\n  rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/aws\n  echo \"AWS CLI v2 설치 완료: $(aws --version)\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. 시스템 업데이트 및 업그레이드\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. 데스크톱 환경 설치\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서는 install-desktop.sh가 GDM을 설치하지 않을 수 있으므로\n#    ubuntu-desktop을 직접 설치한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nUBUNTU_VERSION=$(lsb_release -rs)\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  apt-get install -y ubuntu-desktop\nelse\n  wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-desktop.sh\n  bash ./install-desktop.sh\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. NICE DCV 설치\n#    install-dcv.sh는 Ubuntu 22.04/18.04만 지원하므로,\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서는 직접 DCV 패키지를 다운로드하여 설치한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  echo \"Ubuntu 24.04 감지 - DCV 직접 설치 (DCV GL 포함)\"\n  wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz\n  tar -xvzf nice-dcv-ubuntu2404-x86_64.tgz\n  cd nice-dcv-*-x86_64\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-server_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-web-viewer_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-xdcv_*.deb\n  apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-gl_*.deb\n  usermod -aG video dcv || true\n  systemctl enable dcvserver || true\n  cd /root\nelse\n  echo \"Ubuntu 22.04 감지 - DCV 설치 (DCV GL 포함)\"\n  wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-dcv.sh\n  bash ./install-dcv.sh\n  # DCV GL 추가 설치 (install-dcv.sh가 DCV GL을 설치하지 않는 경우 대비)\n  if ! dpkg -l nice-dcv-gl 2>/dev/null | grep -q \"^ii\"; then\n    echo \"DCV GL 미설치 감지 - DCV GL을 추가 설치합니다...\"\n    wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/NICE-GPG-KEY\n    gpg --import NICE-GPG-KEY 2>/dev/null || true\n    wget -q https://d1uj6qtbmh3dt5.cloudfront.net/nice-dcv-ubuntu2204-x86_64.tgz\n    tar -xzf nice-dcv-ubuntu2204-x86_64.tgz\n    cd nice-dcv-*-x86_64\n    apt-get install -y ./nice-dcv-gl*.deb\n    cd /root\n  fi\nfi\n\n# DCV GL 활성화 (nvidia-driver.sh에서 xorg.conf 생성 후 reboot 시 적용됨)\nif which dcvgladmin > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  dcvgladmin disable 2>/dev/null || true\n  dcvgladmin enable 2>/dev/null || true\n  echo \"DCV GL 활성화 완료\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. ROS2 설치 (공식 저장소 사용)\n#    ROS2_DISTRO 환경 변수로 배포판 결정 (humble/jazzy)\n#    외부 install-ros.sh 스크립트 대신 직접 설치\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\necho \"ROS2 ${ROS2_DISTRO} 설치 시작...\"\n\n# locale 설정\napt-get install -y locales\nlocale-gen en_US en_US.UTF-8 || true\nupdate-locale LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANG=en_US.UTF-8\nexport LANG=en_US.UTF-8\n\n# ROS2 GPG 키 및 저장소 등록\napt-get install -y software-properties-common curl\ncurl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros/rosdistro/master/ros.key -o /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg\necho \"deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg] http://packages.ros.org/ros2/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $UBUNTU_CODENAME) main\" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list > /dev/null\n\n# ROS2 설치\napt-get update\napt-get install -y ros-${ROS2_DISTRO}-desktop\n\n# rosdep 초기화\n# Ubuntu 24.04(Jazzy)에서는 python3-rosdep2 apt 패키지가 없고,\n# DLAMI에 pip3도 미설치이므로 python3-pip 설치 후 pip로 rosdep 설치\nif apt-cache show python3-rosdep2 2>/dev/null | grep -q \"^Package:\"; then\n  apt-get install -y python3-rosdep2\nelse\n  apt-get install -y python3-pip\n  pip3 install --break-system-packages rosdep\nfi\nrosdep init 2>/dev/null || true\nrosdep update || true\n\n# ROS2 환경 설정을 .bashrc에 추가\necho \"source /opt/ros/${ROS2_DISTRO}/setup.bash\" >> /home/ubuntu/.bashrc\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. Docker 설치 (External_Script)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nwget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws-samples/robotics-boilerplate/main/install-docker.sh\nbash ./install-docker.sh\n\n# ubuntu 사용자를 docker 그룹에 추가 (sudo 없이 docker 명령 실행 가능)\nusermod -aG docker ubuntu || true\n\n# 터미널 모노스페이스 폰트 설정 (DCV에서 글자 간격이 넓어지는 문제 방지)\nrunuser -l ubuntu -c \"gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface monospace-font-name 'Mono Regular 12'\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. DCV 설정 파일 작성\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncat << 'EOF' > /etc/dcv/dcv.conf\n[license]\n[log]\n[session-management]\ncreate-session=true\n[session-management/defaults]\n[session-management/automatic-console-session]\nowner = \"ubuntu\"\nuser = \"ubuntu\"\n[display]\n[connectivity]\nweb-port=8443\n[security]\n[clipboard]\nprimary-selection-paste=true\nprimary-selection-copy=true\nEOF\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 7. 그래픽 관련 패키지 설치 및 GPU 설정\n#    Ubuntu 24.04는 기본 Wayland 모드이므로 DCV를 위해 X11로 전환한다.\n#    GPU X 설정은 NVIDIA 드라이버 설치 후에 실행해야 하므로\n#    nvidia-driver.sh에서 처리한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt install -y mesa-utils openbox\nif echo \"$UBUNTU_VERSION\" | grep -q \"24.04\"; then\n  echo \"Ubuntu 24.04 - Wayland 비활성화 + GDM AutomaticLogin 설정\"\n  # GDM이 설치되어 있으면 설정 적용\n  if [ -f /etc/gdm3/custom.conf ]; then\n    sed -i '/\\[daemon\\]/a WaylandEnable=false\\nAutomaticLoginEnable=true\\nAutomaticLogin=ubuntu' /etc/gdm3/custom.conf 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\n  systemctl set-default graphical.target || true\n  systemctl enable gdm 2>/dev/null || true\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 8. graphics-restart systemd 서비스 생성 및 활성화\n#    DCV 서버 시작 후 그래픽 타겟을 재시작하여 디스플레이를 초기화한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/graphics-restart.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=Restart graphical.target\nAfter=dcvserver.service\n\n[Service]\nExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl isolate graphical.target\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nEOF\n\nsystemctl daemon-reload || true\nsystemctl enable graphics-restart.service || true\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 9. Secrets Manager에서 비밀번호 조회 및 ubuntu 사용자 비밀번호 설정\n#    Ubuntu 24.04에서 SSSD PAM 간섭으로 chpasswd가 실패할 수 있으므로\n#    usermod --password로 직접 설정한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nPASS=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id ${SECRET_ID} --output text --query SecretString --region ${REGION} | jq -r .password)\nHASH=$(echo \"$PASS\" | openssl passwd -6 -stdin)\nusermod --password \"$HASH\" ubuntu || true\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: common.sh =====\""
                  },
                  {
                    "Text": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# nvidia-driver.sh - NVIDIA 드라이버 및 컨테이너 툴킷 설치 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# NVIDIA GPU 드라이버, nvidia-container-toolkit, nvidia-persistenced를 설치한다.\n# DLAMI에 사전 설치된 드라이버 버전에 따라 적절히 처리한다.\n#\n# nvidia-xconfig는 사용하지 않는다. 멀티 GPU 환경에서 --enable-all-gpus가\n# 4개 Screen을 생성하여 DCV와 충돌하므로, DCV 최적화 xorg.conf를 직접 생성한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION - NVIDIA 드라이버 메이저 버전 (예: '570')\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: nvidia-driver.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. NVIDIA 드라이버 설치/교체\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif nvidia-smi > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  INSTALLED_VER=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader | head -1)\n  INSTALLED_MAJOR=$(echo \"$INSTALLED_VER\" | cut -d. -f1)\n  echo \"NVIDIA 드라이버 감지: ${INSTALLED_VER} (메이저: ${INSTALLED_MAJOR}), 요청: ${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}\"\n\n  if [ \"$INSTALLED_MAJOR\" = \"$NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION\" ]; then\n    echo \"드라이버 메이저 버전 일치. 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  elif [ \"$INSTALLED_MAJOR\" = \"550\" ] && [ \"$NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION\" = \"570\" ]; then\n    echo \"DLAMI 550 드라이버 감지. apt로 570 업그레이드합니다...\"\n    apt-get update\n    apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server\n    apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    echo \"nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server 업그레이드 완료\"\n  else\n    echo \"드라이버 메이저 버전 불일치 (${INSTALLED_MAJOR} != ${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}). 교체합니다...\"\n    nvidia-uninstall --silent 2>/dev/null || true\n    dkms remove nvidia/${INSTALLED_VER} --all 2>/dev/null || true\n    apt-get remove --purge -y \"nvidia-fabricmanager*\" 2>/dev/null || true\n    apt-get update\n    apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\n    echo \"nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server 교체 완료\"\n  fi\nelse\n  echo \"NVIDIA 드라이버 미설치. nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server를 설치합니다...\"\n  apt-get update\n  apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server\n  apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-${NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION}-server || true\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. DCV 최적화 xorg.conf 생성 (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 모두)\n#    lspci로 첫 번째 NVIDIA GPU의 PCI BusID를 조회한다.\n#    nvidia-smi는 드라이버 교체 직후 커널 모듈 불일치로 실패할 수 있으므로 사용하지 않는다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nGPU_PCI_SLOT=$(lspci | grep -i nvidia | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1)\nif [ -n \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" ]; then\n  # lspci 형식: 38:00.0 → PCI:56:0:0 (16진수 → 10진수)\n  BUS_HEX=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d: -f1)\n  DEV_HEX=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d: -f2 | cut -d. -f1)\n  FUNC_NUM=$(echo \"$GPU_PCI_SLOT\" | cut -d. -f2)\n  BUS_DEC=$((16#$BUS_HEX))\n  DEV_DEC=$((16#$DEV_HEX))\n  echo \"첫 번째 GPU BusID: PCI:${BUS_DEC}:${DEV_DEC}:${FUNC_NUM}\"\n\n  cat > /etc/X11/xorg.conf << XORGEOF\nSection \"ServerLayout\"\n    Identifier     \"Layout0\"\n    Screen      0  \"Screen0\" 0 0\n    InputDevice    \"Keyboard0\" \"CoreKeyboard\"\n    InputDevice    \"Mouse0\" \"CorePointer\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"InputDevice\"\n    Identifier     \"Keyboard0\"\n    Driver         \"kbd\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"InputDevice\"\n    Identifier     \"Mouse0\"\n    Driver         \"mouse\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Monitor\"\n    Identifier     \"Monitor0\"\n    VendorName     \"Unknown\"\n    ModelName      \"Unknown\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Device\"\n    Identifier     \"Device0\"\n    Driver         \"nvidia\"\n    BusID          \"PCI:${BUS_DEC}:${DEV_DEC}:${FUNC_NUM}\"\n    Option         \"HardDPMS\" \"false\"\nEndSection\n\nSection \"Screen\"\n    Identifier     \"Screen0\"\n    Device         \"Device0\"\n    Monitor        \"Monitor0\"\n    DefaultDepth    24\n    SubSection     \"Display\"\n        Virtual     4096 2160\n        Depth       24\n    EndSubSection\nEndSection\nXORGEOF\n  echo \"DCV 최적화 xorg.conf 생성 완료\"\nelse\n  echo \"lspci에서 NVIDIA GPU를 찾을 수 없습니다. xorg.conf 생성을 건너뜁니다.\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. nvidia-container-toolkit 설치 (DLAMI에 사전 설치된 경우 스킵)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif which nvidia-ctk > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  echo \"nvidia-container-toolkit이 이미 설치되어 있습니다.\"\nelse\n  echo \"nvidia-container-toolkit을 설치합니다...\"\n  curl -fsSL https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/gpgkey | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg\n  curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/deb/nvidia-container-toolkit.list | \\\n    sed 's#deb https://#deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/nvidia-container-toolkit-keyring.gpg] https://#g' | \\\n    tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.list\n  apt-get update\n  apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Docker 재시작 + nvidia-persistenced 활성화\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nsystemctl restart docker || true\nsystemctl enable nvidia-persistenced || true\nsystemctl start nvidia-persistenced || true\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: nvidia-driver.sh =====\""

                    "Text": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# isaac-lab.sh - Isaac Lab Docker 이미지 빌드 및 ECR 푸시 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# IsaacLab 리포지토리를 클론하고, Workshop_Asset(Dockerfile, distributed_run.bash)을\n# 다운로드한 후, Dockerfile에서 Isaac Sim 버전을 패치하여 Docker 이미지를 빌드하고\n# ECR에 푸시한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   ISAAC_SIM_VERSION - Isaac Sim 버전 (예: '4.5.0', '5.1.0', '')\n#   REGION            - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n#   ACCOUNT           - AWS 계정 ID\n#   ECR_REPO_NAME     - ECR 리포지토리 이름 (기본: isaaclab-batch)\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: isaac-lab.sh =====\"\n\n# ECR 리포지토리 이름 기본값\nif [ -z \"$ECR_REPO_NAME\" ]; then\n  ECR_REPO_NAME=\"isaaclab-batch\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. ISAAC_SIM_VERSION이 비어있으면 스킵\n#    isaacSimVersion이 빈 문자열인 프로필에서는 Isaac Sim/Lab 설치를 건너뛴다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nif [ -z \"${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}\" ]; then\n  echo \"ISAAC_SIM_VERSION이 설정되지 않음. Isaac Lab 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  echo \"===== [$(date)] END: isaac-lab.sh (SKIPPED) =====\"\nelse\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. IsaacLab 리포지토리 클론\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment\ngit clone https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab.git\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/IsaacLab\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment/IsaacLab\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. Workshop 에셋 복사 (Dockerfile, distributed_run.bash)\n#    dcv-instance.ts가 UserData 시작 부분에서 /tmp에 기록한 파일을 복사한다.\n#    외부 S3 URL 의존성 없이 리포에 내장된 에셋을 사용한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncp /tmp/workshop-dockerfile Dockerfile\ncp /tmp/workshop-distributed-run distributed_run.bash\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Dockerfile에서 Isaac Sim 버전 sed 패치\n#    베이스 이미지를 지정된 버전으로 교체하고,\n#    Isaac Sim 5.x 이상에서는 추가 EULA 동의가 필요하다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nsed -i \"s|FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim:.*|FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim:${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}|g\" Dockerfile\n\nMAJOR_VER=$(echo \"${ISAAC_SIM_VERSION}\" | cut -d. -f1)\nif [ \"${MAJOR_VER}\" -ge 5 ] 2>/dev/null; then\n  # 5.x: ACCEPT_EULA + OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA + USER root\n  sed -i '/^FROM/a ENV ACCEPT_EULA=Y\\nENV OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA=YES\\nUSER root' Dockerfile\nelse\n  # 4.x: EULA 불필요\n  :\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. Docker 이미지 빌드\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndocker build -t ${ECR_REPO_NAME}:latest .\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6.                     "Text": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# efs-mount.sh - EFS 마운트 및 사전 학습 모델 다운로드 스크립트\n# =============================================================================\n# EFS 파일 시스템을 /home/ubuntu/environment/efs에 마운트하고,\n# 사전 학습된 모델 파일(agent_72000.pt)을 EFS에 다운로드한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   EFS_ID - EFS 파일 시스템 ID (예: fs-xxxxxxxx)\n#   REGION - AWS 리전 (예: us-east-1)\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: efs-mount.sh =====\"\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 1. nfs-common 설치\n#    NFS v4 마운트에 필요한 패키지를 설치한다.\n#    (amazon-efs-utils는 Ubuntu 기본 저장소에 없으므로 nfs-common 사용)\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\napt-get install -y nfs-common\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2. EFS 마운트 디렉토리 생성 및 마운트\n#    NFS v4.1 프로토콜로 EFS 파일 시스템을 마운트한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\nmount -t nfs4 -o nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2 ${EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 2-1. fstab에 EFS 마운트 항목 등록 (reboot 후 자동 재마운트)\n#      중복 등록을 방지하기 위해 grep으로 기존 항목을 확인한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nFSTAB_ENTRY=\"${EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs nfs4 nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2,_netdev,nofail 0 0\"\nif ! grep -q \"${EFS_ID}.efs\" /etc/fstab; then\n  echo \"$FSTAB_ENTRY\" >> /etc/fstab\n  echo \"fstab에 EFS 마운트 항목 등록 완료\"\nfi\n\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 3. 사전 학습된 모델 파일 다운로드\n#    Workshop_Asset 중 agent_72000.pt를 EFS에 다운로드한다.\n# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\nwget -P /home/ubuntu/environment/efs https://ws-assets-prod-iad-r-pdx-f3b3f9f1a7d6a3d0.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/075ce3fe-6888-4ea9-986e-5bdd1b767ef7/agent_72000.pt || echo \"[WARN] 사전 학습 모델 다운로드 실패 — 수동 다운로드 필요\"\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: efs-mount.sh =====\""

                    "Text": "#!/bin/bash -e\n# =============================================================================\n# groot.sh - GR00T N1 Docker 빌드 + 추론 서버 systemd 서비스 설정\n# =============================================================================\n# GR00T 리포지토리를 클론하고, Docker 이미지를 빌드하며,\n# 부팅 시 자동으로 추론 서버를 실행하는 systemd 서비스를 등록한다.\n# EFS에 GR00T-N1.6-3B 모델 가중치를 다운로드한다.\n#\n# 입력 환경 변수:\n#   GROOT_REPO   - GR00T GitHub 리포지토리 URL\n#   GROOT_BRANCH - GR00T 리포지토리 브랜치\n#   EFS_ID       - EFS 파일 시스템 ID\n#   REGION       - AWS 리전\n# =============================================================================\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] START: groot.sh =====\"\n\n# GROOT_REPO가 비어있으면 스킵\nif [ -z \"$GROOT_REPO\" ]; then\n  echo \"GROOT_REPO가 설정되지 않음. GR00T 설치를 건너뜁니다.\"\n  echo \"===== [$(date)] END: groot.sh (SKIPPED) =====\"\n  return 0\nfi\n\n# --- 1. HuggingFace에서 GR00T 모델 가중치 다운로드 (EFS) ---\n# Ubuntu 24.04 DLAMI에는 pip3가 미설치이므로 먼저 확인\nif ! which pip3 > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n  apt-get install -y python3-pip\nfi\npip3 install --break-system-packages -q huggingface_hub\nif [ ! -d /home/ubuntu/environment/efs/GR00T-N1.6-3B ]; then\n  python3 -c \"from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('nvidia/GR00T-N1.6-3B', local_dir='/home/ubuntu/environment/efs/GR00T-N1.6-3B')\"\nfi\n\n# --- 2. GR00T 리포지토리 클론 + Dockerfile 생성 ---\nmkdir -p /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\ncd /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\ngit clone --branch $GROOT_BRANCH $GROOT_REPO gr00t\n\ncat << 'GROOT_DOCKERFILE' > Dockerfile\nFROM nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.04-py3\nENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive\nENV PIP_CONSTRAINT=\"\"\nCOPY gr00t/ /workspace/gr00t/\nWORKDIR /workspace/gr00t\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e .\nEXPOSE 5555\nENTRYPOINT [\"python\"]\nCMD [\"gr00t/eval/run_gr00t_server.py\"]\nGROOT_DOCKERFILE\n\nchown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker\n\n# --- 3. GR00T Docker 빌드 systemd 서비스 ---\ncat << 'GROOTSVC' > /etc/systemd/system/groot-docker-build.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=GR00T Docker Build\nAfter=docker.service\nRequires=docker.service\nConditionPathExists=!/var/groot-done\n\n[Service]\nType=oneshot\nRemainAfterExit=yes\nExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'docker build -t groot-n1:latest /home/ubuntu/environment/groot_docker && touch /var/groot-done'\nExecStartPost=/bin/systemctl --no-block start groot-inference.service\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nGROOTSVC\n\n# --- 4. GR00T 추론 서버 systemd 서비스 ---\ncat << GROOTINFSVC > /etc/systemd/system/groot-inference.service\n[Unit]\nDescription=GR00T Inference Server\nAfter=groot-docker-build.service network-online.target\nWants=network-online.target\n\n[Service]\nType=simple\nRestart=on-failure\nExecStartPre=/bin/bash -c 'mount -t nfs4 -o nfsvers=4.1,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576,hard,timeo=600,retrans=2 $EFS_ID.efs.$REGION.amazonaws.com:/ /home/ubuntu/environment/efs 2>/dev/null || true'\nExecStart=docker run --rm --gpus all --name groot-inference --network=host -v /home/ubuntu/environment/efs:/workspace/weights groot-n1:latest gr00t/eval/run_gr00t_server.py --model_path /workspace/weights/GR00T-N1.6-3B --embodiment_tag GR1 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5555\n\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\nGROOTINFSVC\n\nsystemctl daemon-reload\nsystemctl enable groot-docker-build.service\nsystemctl enable groot-inference.service\n\necho \"===== [$(date)] END: groot.sh =====\""
                  },
